summary: FriendPlace Mini-CMS Events module (Session A) verified end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering CRUD, slug uniqueness (-2/-3 suffix), publish guards (title+starts_at, both server- and client-side), cascade delete of RSVPs, waitlist auto-flip at capacity, auto-promotion of the first waitlist row when a going RSVP is cancelled, public projection (no admin fields leaked, upcoming+published+visible only, sorted by starts_at asc), draft/hidden 404 on public /{slug}, and stats.events_count / events_upcoming_count integers reflecting live state. Frontend: sidebar 'Events' entry, dashboard 'Upcoming events' 6th tile, 'Add Event' quick action, empty state, '+ New event' → editor, editor sections (Title, When w/ tz picker, Where w/ online toggle, Cover image, Visibility toggles, RSVPs w/ Going/Waitlist stats) render, publish guard toast fires without starts_at, and ?new=1 quick action creates+routes. Cleanup left both cms_events and event_rsvps empty.
critical_code_review_comments: Public /events filter uses lexical ISO comparison ev['starts_at'] >= now — works because backend stamps everything via _now_iso() (UTC +00:00 with same offset), but any admin who pastes a starts_at in a different offset (e.g. +11:00) could sort/compare unpredictably. Consider parsing to datetime for the comparison. Not blocking for Session A.

cms_events collection has no unique index on `slug` — uniqueness is enforced only by _unique_slug()'s find loop, so a concurrent race could still produce duplicates. Low risk for a single-admin CMS but worth an index on ({slug: 1}, unique) later.
Admin editor page (`/admin/events/[id]/page.tsx`) is 525 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider extracting the preview modal and helpers into siblings in a follow-up.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Every created event was deleted (cascade), leaving cms_events and event_rsvps at 0 rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter67_events.py mints admin JWTs via cms_module._make_admin_token after loading /app/backend/.env — reuse the same pattern. Admin id is looked up dynamically so it works regardless of which admin email exists. The teardown fixture sweeps any TEST_-prefixed events so re-runs are idempotent.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Waitlist auto-flip (capacity=2, third RSVP → waitlist), promotion on cancel (first waitlist row → going, counts sync), cascade delete (0 orphan RSVPs after event delete), and public payload leaks (created_by/status/hidden/updated_at all absent) all behave as spec'd.
